scope: Six selected photographs with manually reviewed image-level and primary-vehicle helmet labels. Includes one existing private user upload. Investigation smoke checks, not held-out production evaluation.
limitations: These six photos were inspected during implementation; metrics are smoke results, not held-out generalization estimates.
Primary-vehicle labels refer to the visually prominent foreground subject, not measured camera distance.
The private saved rider upload remains local; its external redistribution rights are not verified.
One real readable plate was manually transcribed during this fix. Its OCR result is a regression smoke check, not held-out Pakistan OCR accuracy.
No real labeled positive occupancy ground truth; occupancy metrics remain unavailable.
No per-object localization, per-rider recall, legal guilt, or vehicle movement ground truth.
